name: ia-hypermiler
description: Desktop widget that monitors AI token usage (Claude and GitHub Copilot) and computes an optimal daily budget.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run copy-assets
scripts.test: npm run build && cd dist && node --env-file-if-exists=../.env.test --test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.test.json --noEmit
scripts.coverage: npm run build && cd dist && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/*.test.js" --test-coverage-exclude="tests/**"

author: Daniele 'suppressio' <82306300+suppressio@users.noreply.github.com>
